_comment: Mutations that put the AGPL-3.0 section 13 'no human in the loop' defect
BACK into the branch.
The defect (measured 2026-11-07, Copilot engine on panel #3, condition (a) --
'the downloadable archive can differ from the running version; obtaining
the exact commit depends on the email request being honored'): the offer
pointed at the archive of the TIP of `main` and told the reader that
'the running service does not print a commit id', so the ONLY way to get
the source of the build you were actually talking to was to ask a human by
email. The fix makes the running deployment publish its own commit:
update.sh records the commit it is about to build into .env, the api
serves it as the `commit` field of the unauthenticated GET /api/v1/status,
and the offer page turns that value into the archive URL for that commit.
M1 drops the commit from the status payload (the field is still there, but
it is always null). Killed by
test_the_status_endpoint_reports_the_commit_the_deployment_was_built_from
and test_the_status_endpoint_answers_when_no_commit_was_recorded.
M2 stops reading DEPLOYED_COMMIT from the environment, so the endpoint can
never report the build it is running. Killed by
test_the_deployed_commit_is_read_from_the_environment.
M3 removes the `commit` field from the SystemStatus schema. Killed by the
same two endpoint tests: the response no longer carries the commit.
M4 stops the deploy stamp recording the commit, so the running container
can never know which build it is. The stamping logic lives in
ops/scripts/record_deployed_commit.sh (ONE implementation, shared by
update.sh and the MANUAL deploy in AGENTS.md -- the manual path is the
one the operator actually uses). M4 was filed HERE and it SURVIVED
(measured 2026-11-09). It was not a hole in the PRODUCT: it was a
MISFILED MUTANT. The pytest_target of this spec is four test files,
NONE of which is a test of the stamp script, so no test in this
target could ever observe a defect injected into it -- and the
harness reported a survivor for a FILING reason, which reads to a
human like a hole in the product. M4 has been MOVED to
tools/mutations/deployed_commit_script.json, whose target contains
the tests that read the script's bytes (needle and replace string
byte-identical). tests/test_mutation_specs_must_be_observable_by_
their_own_target.py now pins that invariant, so a mutant can never
again be filed under a spec that cannot observe it.
M5 points the page back at the branch tip instead of the published commit,
which puts the human-in-the-loop email back in charge. Killed by
test_the_page_gives_the_archive_url_for_that_exact_commit.
M6-M15 put the FOUR defects measured by the 2026-11-09 review panel
BACK into the branch. Each one was measured in the code by the parent
before it was treated as real.
M6 -- update.sh never re-created the api. docker-compose.yml gives the
api service `env_file: .env`, and a container's environment is fixed
when the container is CREATED, so `docker compose up -d --build`
(which does not re-create a container whose image id did not change)
left the api publishing the PREVIOUS commit while the rest of the
deployment ran the new code. Killed by
test_update_sh_recreates_the_api_container,
test_the_api_is_recreated_after_the_build and
test_the_api_is_recreated_after_the_stamp.
M7 -- the deploy gate never FETCHED the archive the offer names, so a
404, an empty archive or an archive of a commit that does not exist
all passed. Killed by
test_it_asks_for_the_archive_of_the_stamped_commit (the stub curl
records every request: no request, no proof).
M8 -- the deploy gate accepted an archive that is not there. Killed by
test_an_archive_that_is_not_there_fails_the_gate and
test_the_failure_says_what_is_wrong.
M9 -- the deploy gate accepted an EMPTY archive (a 200 with no bytes).
Killed by test_an_empty_archive_fails_the_gate.
M10 -- the fallback project directory knew only ONE install location.
deploy.sh clones into /opt/depthsight and its cron runs
/opt/depthsight/update.sh, so the auto-update was dead on every
one-click host. Killed by
test_the_fallback_knows_both_install_locations and
test_the_fallback_resolves_to_the_location_that_exists (the real
command is run against fixture directories).
M11 -- the manual deploy rebuilt only the bot. Six services build from
the ROOT context and the api IMPORTS bot_module, so the api, the
market-data service, the celery worker and the mcp-memory server
kept running the OLD code. Killed by
test_the_manual_deploy_rebuilds_every_service_from_this_repository.
M12 -- the manual deploy re-created only the bot. Killed by
test_the_manual_deploy_recreates_every_service_from_this_repository.
M13 -- the smoke test never fetched the archive. Killed by
TestTheSmokeTestFetchesTheArchive.
M14 -- the smoke test accepted an archive that is not there. Killed by
test_an_archive_that_is_not_there_fails_the_smoke_test.
M15 -- the smoke test accepted an EMPTY archive. Killed by
test_an_empty_archive_fails_the_smoke_test.
M16 -- the MANUAL deploy sequence in AGENTS.md has no stop-on-error, so a
FAILED BUILD is followed by `--force-recreate api`: the api is then
re-created from the OLD image with the NEW stamp already in its
environment, so the running service publishes a commit whose code it
is NOT running, and the offer names an archive that is not the
running build. Killed by
test_the_manual_deploy_block_stops_at_the_first_failed_step.
EVERY NEEDLE IS ASSERTED UNIQUE BEFORE USE: each needle below occurs
EXACTLY ONCE in its file, measured before the mutation was written. A
needle that matched two sites would make the mutation meaningless,
because the harness replaces only the first hit.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/source_offer_deployed_commit.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: M1: the status endpoint stops reporting the built commit (the field is always null)
M2: the api stops reading DEPLOYED_COMMIT, so it can never report the build it is running
M3: the SystemStatus schema drops the commit field, so the response cannot carry it
M5: the offer points at the branch tip again instead of the published commit
M6: the deploy no longer re-creates the api container, so it keeps publishing the PREVIOUS commit while the rest of the deployment runs the new code
M7: the deploy gate never fetches the archive the offer names, so a 404 or an empty archive passes every gate
M8: the deploy gate accepts an archive that is not there, so the offer can promise a 404
M9: the deploy gate accepts an EMPTY archive, so the offer can promise a file with no bytes in it
mutations.needle:
if [ ! -s "$tmp" ]; then
        rm -f "$tmp"
        echo "FAIL: the source archive the offer names is empty: GET $url returned HTTP 200 and no bytes"
        return 1
    fi

mutations.label: M10: the auto-updater's fallback only knows ONE install location, so the one-click installer's cron can never update anything again
M11: the manual deploy rebuilds only the bot, so the api, the market-data service, the celery worker and the mcp-memory server keep running the OLD code while the api publishes the NEW commit
mutations.needle: docker compose build --no-cache mcp-memory api websocket bot market_data celery_worker frontend pwa ops

mutations.label: M12: the manual deploy re-creates only the bot, so a service whose image was rebuilt keeps running the container it was created from
mutations.needle: docker compose up -d --no-deps mcp-memory api websocket bot market_data celery_worker frontend pwa ops

mutations.label: M13: the smoke test never fetches the archive the offer names, so a 404 or an empty archive passes the smoke test
M14: the smoke test accepts an archive that is not there
M15: the smoke test accepts an EMPTY archive

M16: the MANUAL deploy sequence has no stop-on-error, so a FAILED BUILD is followed by a recreate of the api from the OLD image with the NEW stamp in its environment -- the running service would publish a commit whose code it is not running
